# Reflexive Descent to Minimal Seeds in the Kreuzer–Skarke List, release 1.0.1

The paper now cites its archive by the Zenodo version DOI of release 1.0.0, 10.5281/zenodo.23483240, and the citation file and the README list that DOI and the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23483239 of all versions. The repository also holds `ReflexiveDescent_masterzipfinal2.zip`, which collects the paper, its LaTeX source, the arXiv package and the full archive in one file.

The mathematics, the data, the 77 checks and the 24 Lean 4 theorems are those of release 1.0.0: 22 ≤ D_4 ≤ 348, two polytopes of depth exactly 22, and a descent of the 680-point polytope in at most 31 steps.

Assets: the PDF, the LaTeX source with the figures as PNG (tex.zip), and the arXiv package (tar.gz) with the checks, the data and the Lean file in `anc/`.
